definitions.descent_conditional: ISO_r only for r with p_{r-1} >= p_r
definitions.wr_gap: (first r with WR_r violated) - L(alpha); >= 0 means WR holds for all r < L(alpha)

empty_graph_formula.ratio_r=Q_r/(p_{r-1}p_r): (m+1)/(m-r+1) >= (m+1)/m > 1, min at r=1; infimum over m is 1 (never attained)
empty_graph_formula.asymptotic: at r ~ m theta/(1+theta) (tilt theta = p_{r-1}/p_r), ratio -> 1+theta; descents (r>=(m+1)/2) have ratio >= 2(m+1)/(m+2) -> 2

r2_theorem.statement: For every forest with n vertices and e edges, Q_2 >= (n-e)(3en-4e+n^2+n)/2 > 0; equality iff the forest is K_{1,e} + (n-1-e)K_1. Hence ISO_2 can never fail for forests (in fact for any triangle-free graph with e < n), even though inf ratio_2 = 0 (stars).
r2_theorem.proof_sketch: p_1=n, p_2=C(n,2)-e, p_3=C(n,3)-e(n-2)+D, D=sum_v C(d_v,2) <= C(e,2); Q_2 decreasing in D.

asymptotic_mT_dispersion_test.description: For m copies of T (m->inf), ratio_r -> R_inf(theta) = [mu - sigma^2 (1-theta^2)]/(theta sigma^2) at tilt theta=p_{r-1}/p_r in (0,1]; ISO fails for large m iff G(theta)=(1-theta^2)(I I' + theta I I'' - theta I'^2) - I' I^2 > 0 somewhere on (0,1). Sturm root count of G on (0,1) plus sign at 1/2 decides exactly; grid min of R_inf reported.

verdicts.note_descent: If LC_r holds and p_{r-1} >= p_r then Q_r/(p_{r-1}p_r) = r t + 1/t - (r+1) s >= 1/t - t >= 0 (t=p_r/p_{r-1}<=1, s<=t). So a descent-conditional ISO failure requires an LC failure at a descent; none were found.
